mistakes.questionTitle: Honeybee Communication in the Hive - Question 3
mistakes.whyItWasWrong: You thought the distance wasn't stated, but the passage clearly said 'bees travel up to five kilometers'. Since 5 km is more than 1 km, the statement is FALSE, not missing.
